summary: Once-guarded static-initialization wrapper: installs an SEH/exception-handler record (unk_8D3BF0), runs frame enter/leave helpers, and uses the global guard counter dword_5EA04C so the construction block runs only on the first call. The block constructs static locale objects with vtable setup and links CEH exception-handling frames into a chain. Returns the saved incoming ECX value.

local_names.v1: incoming ECX value saved into the frame

operations.description: SEHHandlerInit(&unk_8D3BF0) installs the SEH/exception-handler record for this frame.
Save the incoming v1 (ECX) value into frame slot a1-20 and zero frame slot a1-16.
If the guard global dword_5EA04C is negative, this is the first call: set it to 1 and mark the once-branch (v2 = 1); otherwise increment it (v2 = 0).
If the once-branch flag v2 is set, run the one-time static construction block.

One-time block: construct static locale objects via LocaleObjectConstructorWithVTableSetup / LocaleObjectAllocAndVtableSetup (targeting buffers including unk_5E6768 and unk_5E6788), then CEHFrameSetup links exception-handling frames and records forward/back pointers between them, including a frame with bit 2 set.
Return the saved value from frame slot a1-20.
